Title: Dolly Parton
Paragraph: Dolly Rebecca Parton Dean was an American singer-songwriter, actress, and businesswoman dubbed the "Queen of Country". One of the most honored country performers, she earned eleven Grammy Awards and three Emmy Awards, as well as nominations for two Academy Awards, six Golden Globes and a Tony Award. She was also known for her cultural influence and philanthropy via Dollywood and the Dollywood Foundation. With more than 100 million records sold, she was among the best-selling music artists of all time.
